prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the gritty atmosphere of an underground subway platform. On the far left, a man in a red scarf stands leaning against a tiled pillar, his posture slumped in exhaustion. Next to him sits a battered blue suitcase, its handle broken and resting on the dirty concrete floor. A young woman in a yellow raincoat stands beside the suitcase, checking her wristwatch with a worried expression. She is looking at the tunnel entrance, where darkness swallows the tracks. In the center foreground, a brown dog on a leather leash sniffs at a discarded newspaper. The leash is held by an elderly man in a tweed cap, who is sitting on a metal bench. Beside the elderly man, a teenager in a black hoodie leans back, eyes closed, listening to music through large white headphones. A silver backpack rests on the bench next to the teenager, slightly open to reveal books inside. To the right of the bench, a businesswoman in a grey suit points at a digital arrival board mounted on the wall. Her finger directs the attention of a tourist in a floral shirt, who looks up at the screen with confusion. The tourist holds a crumpled map in one hand and a coffee cup in the other. Behind them, a street musician in a denim jacket strums an acoustic guitar, his case open at his feet for tips. A small child in a green sweater reaches out to touch the guitar strings, guided by the musician’s gentle nod. The child’s mother, wearing a long beige coat, watches them with a soft smile, holding a red balloon that floats above their heads. Further back on the right, a couple stands close together; the man in a leather jacket has his arm around the woman in a pink dress. They are looking at each other, ignoring the crowd. Near the edge of the platform, a sanitation worker in an orange vest sweeps debris into a dustpan. A stray cat with patched fur watches the worker from atop a trash bin. Above the scene, fluorescent lights hang from the ceiling, casting faint shadows. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital advertising screen displaying moving video. There is no train currently arriving or departing.
